title: OrgAuthorityAssertionV1 (v1.1)
description: Console-signed assertion that a console user who is an owner or admin of the approval's org approved one specific approval, after a server-side step-up. Evidence for the `atlasent_verified_org_authority` approver basis (atlasent-api#3798, B2a). It takes the place of `identity_assertion` and `approver_grant_assertion` in an approval_artifact.v1 (never alongside either). subject.principal_id is the RUNTIME principal the console user maps to; subject.console_user_id is the console user. The runtime admits the assertion only for an org_role the approval's snapshot admits, re-checks membership and role when the approval commits, and consumes the nonce once. Lifetime is at most five minutes and the step-up at most five minutes old when issued; both are enforced by the runtime verifier, not by this schema. Ed25519 signature (base64url, no padding) over the canonical JSON of every field except `signature`, under a key from the runtime's ORG_AUTHORITY_TRUSTED_ISSUERS. Mirrored from atlasent-api/supabase/functions/_shared/org_authority_assertion.ts (OrgAuthorityAssertionV1 / isOrgAuthorityAssertion) and atlasent-sdk/contract/schemas/org-authority-assertion.schema.json; they MUST stay in lockstep. Wire-stable as `org_authority_assertion.v1`. Added 2026-10-03, additive only.

principal_id.description: Runtime principal the console user maps to.
